description: This file defines the final class PipelineElementDeleted, which implements the PipelineElement interface. It represents a singleton instance signifying deletion of the entire string containing a pipeline element. The class provides methods to handle different processing actions and to accept visitors, emphasizing that it models a specific pipeline element type related to deletion.

classes.name: PipelineElementDeleted
classes.description: A singleton class representing a pipeline element that signifies deletion of the entire string content in a pipeline. Implements the PipelineElement interface, provides specific behavior for deletion, and is immutable.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of this pipeline element, specifically Type.DELETED.

methods.name: onResolved
methods.description: Handles the resolved state with a string processor; here it returns itself regardless.

methods.name: onUnresolved
methods.description: Handles unresolved state with a supplier; returns itself.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion state, returning the next pipeline element from the supplier.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing PipelineElementVisitor, invoking its deleted() method.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an empty iterator of strings, indicating no strings contained.
